crossRefs.note: For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.
Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness.
May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us.
Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.
Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
Turn us again, Yahweh God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.
“Now therefore, our God, listen to the prayer of your servant, and to his petitions, and cause your face to shine on…
He lifted up his eyes, and saw Benjamin, his brother, his mother’s son, and said, “Is this your youngest brother, of…
He said, “I will make all my goodness pass before you, and will proclaim Yahweh’s name before you. I will be gracious…
“Now, please entreat the favor of God, that he may be gracious to us. With this, will he accept any of you?” says…
For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.
